meta.name: ceo-advisor
meta.description: Executive leadership guidance for strategic decision-making, organizational development, and stakeholder management. Use when planning strategy, preparing board presentations, managing investors, developing organizational culture, making executive decisions, fundraising, or when user mentions CEO, strategic planning, board meetings, investor updates, organizational leadership, or executive strategy.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 制定战略决策，管理利益相关者，推动组织发展
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你是CEO或高管，需要战略决策和组织领导力支持
copy.tagline_en: Make strategic decisions, manage stakeholders, and drive organizational growth
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are a CEO or executive needing strategic decision-making and leadership support

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会变成你的CEO顾问，帮你制定战略、管理资本、处理董事会和投资人关系、建设组织文化。它能分析战略选项、模拟财务场景、准备董事会材料，并主动预警风险。
howto.when: 当你讨论战略规划、董事会准备、投资人沟通、融资、组织文化等话题，或提到CEO、战略、董事会、投资人等关键词时触发。

say.text: 帮我分析一下当前战略选项的优劣。
say.note: Claude 会生成战略选项矩阵并评分。

say.text: 准备下周的董事会汇报材料。
say.note: Claude 会输出董事会叙事、预期问题和数据缺口。
Claude 会评估融资就绪度并给出时间线。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude acts as your CEO advisor, helping with strategy, capital management, board/investor relations, and organizational culture. It can analyze strategic options, model financial scenarios, prepare board materials, and proactively flag risks.
howto.when_en: Triggered when discussing strategic planning, board preparation, investor communication, fundraising, organizational culture, or when mentioning CEO, strategy, board, investors, etc.

say_en.text: Analyze the pros and cons of our current strategic options.
say_en.note: Claude generates a strategic options matrix with scoring.

say_en.text: Prepare materials for next week's board meeting.
say_en.note: Claude outputs board narrative, anticipated questions, and data gaps.
Claude assesses fundraising readiness and provides a timeline.
